jack-axe: Be Jack! Get an axe! Take Jack (and her sisters) on an axe tossing, single or multiplayer, platforming adventure in a vibrant open world inspired by Filipino and Norse mythology.
olliolli-switch-stance: With over 75 Awards and Nominations including BAFTA Best Sports Title 2015, OlliOlli: Switch Stance includes both OlliOlli and OlliOlli2: Welcome to Olliwood - bringing together the defining Skateboarding Series of this generation!
roombo-first-blood: Roombo: First Blood is a comedic, top-down, stealth-action game about being a robot vacuum cleaner and fending off burglars that have broken into your home. A Samurai Punk Short.
necrosphere-deluxe: Necrosphere is a (really difficult) bite-sized metroidvania game you control with only two buttons!
quest-for-the-golden-duck: Run around the maze collecting coins while being chased by spooky monsters. Outsmart the enemies in 4-player co-op games, or play the versus mode as a monster to prevent the other team from stealing all the gold from the castle.
pumped-bmx-pro: Developed by one man studio Yeah Us! Games, Pumped BMX Pro is the sequel to the hugely successful Pumped BMX +. The momentum-based BMX freestyler takes the action to the next level with a beautiful new look, a fresh new physics engine and more content than ever before!
save-koch: You are local mafia kingpin, Jeffrey Koch. Your empire in New Kandinski is in total chaos because an unknown Mastermind has decided to take your place. And they’ve planted a sleeper Mole inside your operation. It’s time to act, but you need to act smart.
legal-dungeon: Legal Dungeon is a game about organizing police investigation documents. This game has 14 endings and 6 achievements, as well as a cute Screen Mate shop. Judge the lives of others and collect all items!
sky-racket: The universe is in peril! Two kids are chosen to hold the powerful artifact "Sky Racket" and put a stop to an evil tyrant. Play as Racket Boy or Racket Girl, and with the help of cute and strong buddies, save this nonsense dystopian pixel art universe.
rbi-baseball-19: R.B.I. Baseball 19 takes the field with more additions and improvements than ever before! R.B.I. 19 delivers a genuine MLB experience with heightened authenticity and incredible depth including the ability to manage your MLB franchise across multiple seasons, hundreds of new animations, updated player models, every…
the-secret-order-7-shadow-breach: There are dark secrets that have an annoying tendency to crawl back into the light, escaping oblivion. But there is also Sarah Pennington, the most skilled agent of the ever-watching Secret Order, who is there to face them.
mistover: ''MIST-ical' RPG with expeditions for finding the key to survival. Choose your next step wisely and keep in mind that your every move will change the future.
the-7th-guest-25th-anniversary-edition: The famous game remastered in a new 25th Anniversary Edition! The father and mother of all 'Haunted Mansion' games. Winner of multiple gaming awards and "No. 1 Rated Game of 1994".
tetragon: Tetragon is a vast mysterious universe of unique puzzles, magical mazes, and challenges! Your goal is to move the plane realities using the spinning world gravity wisely. Test your mind and guide the brave lumberjack through the scattered worlds in search of his lost son!
doomsday-vault: Rescue Earth’s precious plant life. In your robotic suit navigate a flooded city, break into an underground lair and explore ancient pyramids. chippy: Chippy is a twin-stick bullet-hell shooter. Chip apart destructible bosses pixel-by-pixel.
seed-of-life: Seed of Life is an epic adventure game about the persistence of life. You're Cora, the last known survivor of Lumia, a dying planet. Your only hope to save your homeworld is to activate the Seed of Life and rekindle the sun once again. Will you be the light that conquers the darkness?
whipseey-and-the-lost-atlas: After discovering a magical book, a young boy named Drew is whisked away to Whipseeyland, where he transforms into Whipseey, the pink, whip-wielding hero of this bright, colorful world. With the help of Princess Alyssa, Whipseey embarks on a quest to recover magical orbs that possess the power to return him home.
the-long-return: A beautiful third-person puzzle adventure game telling the story of an orphaned cub that retraces his steps from the last journey he took with his mother. burgertime-party: Peter Pepper's Burger is the hottest grill in town, thanks to its classic menu of award-winning puzzles and patties. arcade-classic-no-1-asteroids-slash-miss: Arcade Classics: Asteroids + Missile Command is a compilation of the two classic arcade games. This bundle also featured enhanced Super Game Boy support.
casino-funpak: In Casino FunPak, you walk around in a casino, partaking in a multitude of games and competing in tournaments to earn as much money as you can. You can play Roulette, Video Poker, Slot Machines, Blackjack and Craps. The tournament mode contains a large tour of the five games.
not-not-a-brain-buster: Downloaded 10 million times on mobiles, this Top 1 Puzzle game in 14 countries (including USA, UK, Australia and Canada) was remastered and features:
snow-bros-jr: The Gameboy port of Snow Bros.
battle-planet-judgement-day: Battle Planet - Judgement Day is a planetary rogue-lite top-down shooter. You are one of the universe's 3 most wanted criminals on the run, fighting your way through hordes of aliens, military and police units. There is only one way to reclaim your freedom - destroy them all...
castlestorm-ii: Aim your catapults! Command your troops! Bloody the battlefield! CastleStorm's charming genre mashup returns, leveling up everything you loved in the original with Unreal Engine 4-powered ruthless destruction. A whole new metagame of strategic conquest adds turn-based tactical intrigue to mix.
depixtion: Welcome to Depixtion, a relaxing puzzle game where you create beautiful works of art using logic. Based on the popular Picross series, Depixtion blends color mixing mechanics with the rules of nonograms to create a uniquely colorful experience.
tetsumo-party: It's Tetsumo Party time! Help sumo warriors win in a hilarious competition. Control their arms and legs to fit the incoming bamboo wall or drop out in the most ridiculous way!
jet-kave-adventure: Jet Kave Adventure brings everything you love about 2.5D platformer. Enjoy the skill-based action, challenging boss fights, clever secrets and thrilling set-pieces in a game where the Stone Age and science fiction collide.
knightin-plus: Join brave sir Lootalot on his epic quest in this little Zelda-lite adventure. Explore and fight your way through the dangerous dungeons filled with traps, puzzles and magical artifacts. And, of course, show the evil bosses who is the real boss here.
hayfever: Help Thomas the Allergic Mailman gather all his lost letters in this challenging and unique 2D platformer! In Hayfever, the player takes control of Thomas – a young postman with a strong work ethic. There is just one tiny little issue… Thomas suffers from terrible (and we mean TERRIBLE) allergies.
biolab-wars: Inspired by the 8-bit games and by the movies from the 80's, your goal is to blow things up, defeat aliens and fight bizarre bosses in this platformer 2D with classic mechanics.
demoniaca-everlasting-night: Demoniaca - is a dark, gothic, mature and sexy action RPG inspired by the Castlevania series. Explore, fight, meet new friends and avenge those who brought you unbearable pain and loss.
witcheye: Witcheye is a big, colorful, old-school platform adventure with a unique touchscreen control system that gives unparalleled control over the hero. Swipe to move and touch to stop, bouncing off of enemies and dodging hazards in six vibrant worlds.
singled-out: In Singled Out you must identify your target in a crowd of alien weirdos before time runs out. The quicker you are, the higher you score!
dragon-quest-1-2-3-collection: A collection of the first 3 dragon quest games planned for release on the Nintendo Switch. No western release was announced but Square Enix Asia listed an English option for the game.
street-outlaws-the-list: Strap-in and put the pedal to the floor cause there’s only enough room for 10! Build, Customize, Race and Earn your way on to the “List", competition is ruthless and everyone is fighting for the respect that comes with the top spot. Your goal? Earn a spot on "The List".
ninnindays: A sullen main character and a clumsy female ninja living together?! In this romantic adventure game set in Akihabara, you'll laugh and you'll cry over the entertaining lifetyle of a slightly erotic female ninja and the main character's cohabitation!
infini: Integrating an outlandish narrative with rigorous mind-bending puzzles, Infini walks a fine line of meditative and chaotic. Standout visuals and concepts are used to create an imaginative and surrealist world where concepts like Poetry, War, Time, and Hope are personified.
earthfall-alien-horde: Earthfall: Alien Horde is a four-player cooperative first-person shooter that challenges players to survive hordes of ruthless alien drones and their inscrutable masters.
void-terrarium: "Even in the darkest times, hope is homegrown. Void Terrarium chronicles the story of a robot and a young girl in a world devastated by enigmatic events. Explore hauntingly beautiful ruins in search of food and supplies, outfit and maintain the "terrarium" in which you live, and do whatever it takes to protect and…
backyard-football--1: Backyard Football, the third "Backyard" game, was developed by Humongous Entertainment and published by GT Interactive in 1999. In it, kids and professional football players as kids play [American] football.
zhed: ZHED is an instant classic puzzle game. Based on a simple mechanic, it builds onto increasingly complex puzzles that challenge you to a level you would not imagine. No timers, no clocks, no stars and no tricks, just pure puzzles for you to enjoy.
voxelgram: Voxelgram is a 3D puzzle game in which voxels must be removed according to hints on their sides, to reveal hidden model. It's a new adaptation of Nonograms also known as Picross and Griddlers.
flatland-vol-dot-1: Flatland - Vol. 1 is a fast-paced hardcore platformer featuring hand-crafted levels and Lightning-fast respawns. Help Square survive his journey to the depths of Flatland, a minimalist neon-style 2D world. Run, jump, die, learn, repeat.
sakura-fox-adventure: Mikoto is a foxgirl and the future head of her clan. One night, she runs away from home to attend a festival at a human village – and there she meets and falls in love with a beautiful female knight.
chaos-field: Chaos Field is a top-down space shooter similar in concept to the Gradius series, or Ikaruga. You control one of three ships, each with their own pilot and unique weapon systems. The game takes place over 5 phases, in each phase you face a number of boss battles.
rez-plz: Take control of two wizard brothers who possess the power of resurrection in a gorgeous pixel-art world. Solve puzzles, platforming challenges, and encounter dangerous monsters and traps that require you to KILL one of the brothers to advance!
korg-ds-10-plus: KORG DS-10 Plus is a music creation program that emulates the Korg MS range of synthesizers.
ubermosh-omega: Ubermosh: Omega, the apex of Walter Machado's Cult Classic series Ubermosh.
super-mega-space-blaster-special-turbo: The definitive 'Turbo Edition' of the easy to play hard to master space blaster. Bringing more game modes, ships, challenges, upgradable power-ups and frantic retro space blasting fun than ever before. Alone or in co-op you’ll keep coming back to unlock ships, upgrade weapons and beat your high-score.
syberia-trilogy: Experience the complete adventures of Kate Walker in this complete box including Syberia 1, 2 and 3. Syberia 1 In Syberia, join Kate Walker on an extraordinary journey that takes her all the way from Western Europe to the far reaches of Eastern Russia.
puddle-knights: A mud-based puzzle game where you use the lengthy capes of chivalrous knights to cover puddles and help members of the upper class away from badly sanitized streets. Solve your way through increasingly tricky puzzles in this lighthearted medieval mindmuck!
jetboard-joust: Classic arcade-style SHMUP meets hardcore modern roguelike! Take flight on a lethal, pimped-up jetboard, darting through the skies and blasting alien invaders with an explosive arsenal of extreme weaponry.
apple-knight: Apple Knight is a modern action platformer with tight controls, fluid player movement, and smooth animation. Explore vast levels filled with secrets, quests and loot. Defeat tough bosses. Fight your way through hordes of evil wizards, knights, and creatures - or activate traps to take them out from a safe distance!
sports-story: Sports story is a game about sports, but not always. Various non-sporting pursuits provide variety. Alternate activities like dungeon exploration, stealthy infiltrations and fishing expeditions mean something unexpected waits around every corner. Sometimes it is even sports.
wire-lips: Play as Leta in this third-person horror game. Puzzle solve in this creepy atmosphere and trying to find collectibles all to help Leta uncover the horrifying mysteries of the ancient artifact...
code-shifter: - Iconic ASW characters remixed in 8-bit pixel art! Characters from all the iconic Arc System Works franchises, including Guilty Gear, BlazBlue, and the River City series, all meet in a 2D pixel art action game! Utilize a whopping 100 characters to successfully adapt and complete all stages!
infinite-beyond-the-mind: Do you stand a chance against the wicked Queen Evangelyn and her army? You're the last hope to prevent her world domination! Infinite Beyond The Mind is a slick 2D action-platformer where you take on evil Queen Evangelyn Bramann, ruler of The Beljantaur Kingdom as she works towards her dream of world domination.
gigantosaurus-the-game: The most exciting episode of Gigantosaurus yet is one you get to play in. But will you be the most roarsome explorer or the fastest racer? Play together with friends and family to help Rocky, Tiny, Mazu and Bill save the day – before dino-dashing to the next zone. Dinosaurs have never had such giant fun!
how-buddys-parents-met: Discover a romance through the eyes of the cat Buddy in this minimalist jigsaw puzzle game, told in 6 scenes illustrated by Katia Numakura with her lovely art style.
puppy-cross: Nonograms and cute dogs, welcome to Puppy Cross!
shieldwall: Shieldwall is a funny third-person tactical battle simulator with strategy elements. It allows you to feel like a squad leader right on the battlefield.
moons-of-darsalon: Retro action "save-them-all" platformer including advanced physics combined with unique rendering pipeline for a consistent retro feel while still using modern lightning. Complete several rescue missions in which you will have to lead companion NPCs to the closest base station.
kosmokrats: Kosmokrats is the People's zero-gravity puzzle adventure game. Pilot your drone to solve dynamic puzzles. Assemble a mighty space fleet to colonize the stars. Will you choose to build a socialist utopia? A post-human technocracy? Or a brutal dictatorship? The choice is yours, comrade!
elsie: Elsie is an indie action-platformer filled with rogue-like mechanics such as perma-death, procedurally generated levels, and a wide scope of items and weaponry to make each run as unique as possible.
cyanide-and-happiness-freakpocalypse: From the creators of Cyanide & Happiness and I-Mockery, comes an all new point-an-click adventure game filled with dark humor, drama, and all the weirdness you've grown to love and/or dread over the years!
shadow-man-remastered: He is coming, stalking criminals in the spirit world and the real world. A possessed man is coming, a voodoo mask in his chest and lines of power in his back. Shadow Man is coming, trailing evil from Liveside to Deadside. To stop an apocalypse. To save your soul.
miden-tower: Miden Tower is a fantasy RPG with a compelling and dramatic story. After Miden Tower is invaded by the Alroval Empire, the mages who call it home find themselves cornered on its upper floors.
professor-lupo-ocean: You wake up in the middle of a crumbling spaceship and yet, somehow, everything’s flooded... You're at the bottom of the Ocean! The ship computer keeps giving you never-ending tasks to repair the ship and is saying you’re a... Clone? The adventure’s only just begun!
shovel-knight-pocket-dungeon: Delve with Shovel Knight into the depths of the Pocket Dungeon in an action-packed puzzle adventure mashup like none other! Join your mysterious guide Puzzle Knight as you shovel through scads of foes, procure new equipment, and battle bosses both familiar and new.
namco-museum-archives-volume-1: Take a trip down memory lane and relive the magical times of the Nintendo Entertainment System with a collection of Namco’s hits and long-lost treasures in Namco Museum Archives Volume 1.
namco-museum-archives-volume-2: Take a trip down memory lane and relive the magical times of the 8-Bit era with a collection of Namco’s hits and long-lost treasures in Namco Museum Archives Volume 2.
mr-driller-drillland: The popular action puzzle game “Mr. DRILLER DrillLand” makes its Western debut! You’re invited to a secret amusement park known as “DrillLand” – 500 meters underground! megaquarium-freshwater-frenzy: Freshwater Frenzy is the first Deluxe Expansion for Megaquarium. Including dozens of new fish, tanks and decorations, not to mention a challenging freshwater-focused campaign! Discover everything the freshwater habitat has to offer in this fully loaded expansion!
rims-racing: The first motorbike simulation that combines a realistic racing challenge with engineering and mechanics! Ride the world's most powerful motorbikes and optimise their performance by swapping out parts and analysing data in real time.
collection-of-saga-final-fantasy-legend: Celebrate the 30th Anniversary of SaGa with one epic collection including the three original Game Boy titles, now updated with new features for Nintendo Switch. clan-oconall-and-the-crown-of-the-stag: A 2D, art driven, puzzle-platformer inspired by Celtic mythology. The game contains rapid, on-the-fly character swapping, flashy attack combos and complex platforming challenges, packaged in gorgeous artwork inspired by mysterious Celtic folklore.
saviors-of-sapphire-wings-slash-stranger: A pack containing the ports of 2 PlayStation Vita games that were previously only available in Japan. Saviors of Sapphire Wings, a remake of Entaku no Seito (Students of Round), and Stranger of Sword City Revisited. "Discover a tale of war, darkness, and the power of bonds, coming to the West for the first time!
disgaea-6-defiance-of-destiny: The first new Disgaea game in six years is here! Meet Zed, a zombie that has risen above them all except one - a God of Destruction! Can a mere Netherworld zombie rise up and destroy a god? Find out in the newest installment of the Disgaea series!

evolution-board-game: Inspired by the board game with more than 1.6 million players, Evolution sets a new standard for digital tabletop. Adapt, survive, and thrive in a beautiful and ever-changing ecosystem enhanced by incredible art and thoughtful, balanced mechanics.
alpaca-ball-allstars: Alpaca Ball: Allstars is a physics based football game featuring alpacas as players. Instead of using their feet to play the ball, these alpacas play the ball with their heads and oversized necks.
crossbow-bloodnight: Crossbow: Bloodnight is a frantic score-attack arena shooter set in a world of camp horror and gore. Master the occult powers of your automatic crossbow and fight for every second of survival against a relentless demonic horde! Hunt. Die. Hunt again.
gal-star-gun-returns: Part shooting game and part dating sim, the game tells the story of a young man becoming so incredibly popular with the opposite sex, that he has to fend off his array of admirers!
worm-jazz: Worm Jazz is a wriggly puzzler with a unique blend of game mechanics inspired by familiar classics such as Snake 🐍 and Bomberman 💣. You take control of Mr. Mark, an earthworm with a particular fondness for smooth jazz and dapper headwear.
doctor-who-the-edge-of-reality: Doctor Who: The Edge Of Reality reimagines last year’s VR experience with brand-new gameplay, new monsters and new worlds to explore. phantom-breaker-omnia: Phantom Breaker Omnia is a fast-paced 2-D anime fighting game that features 20 unique characters, pitted against one another to make their greatest wishes come true. The ability to choose between 3 fighting styles will appeal to seasoned gamers while making the game accessible to newcomers.
spookware: Microgames done spooky! Equal parts cute, creepy, and exciting, over 200 microgames across a dozen unique levels. A fast-paced adventure game with a twist.
drawn-to-life-two-realms: The quirky Raposa and your drawn hero return in Drawn to Life: Two Realms, the next installment in the beloved franchise! Uncover the mystery of the Shadow and save Mike and his friends.
clockwork-aquario: Clockwork Aquario was the last arcade game ever developed by the legendary Westone Bit Entertainment in 1992, but was never finished. time-master: Time Master is a fantasy themed time manipulation puzzle game. Rewind time and collaborate with your past self to solve dozens of hand-crafted puzzles.
kitsune-tails: Run, jump, and dash across a land inspired by Japanese mythology and untangle the love triangle between three young women on a journey of self discovery. Explore the complicated relationships between kitsune and humans through classic platforming action.
the-plane-effect: Players take on the role of Solo, a lonely office worker who's trying to get home to his family after his last day of work. Somewhat worryingly, it seems Solo experiences some trouble remembering his family, and also has to contend with the shifting balance of space and time.
atelier-mysterious-trilogy-dx: The definitive edition of the Mysterious trilogy titles, featuring new content and a variety of previously released downloadable content. faraday-protocol: Faraday Protocol is a first-person, story-driven puzzle game that will award you with a solid sense of accomplishment when overcoming its challenges. You are Raug Zeekon, interstellar archeologist from planet Cunor.
samurai-warriors-5: Experience exhilarating action set in a dramatic historical setting in SAMURAI WARRIORS 5. As the latest numbered entry in the SAMURAI WARRIORS franchise, the story, characters, and visuals have been re-imagined to set the stage for a thrilling new series.
blizzard-arcade-collection: Relive the Legacy Experience a blast from Blizzard's past! The Blizzard Arcade Collection brings three of our classic console games to modern platforms and new audiences.
famicom-detective-club-the-two-case-coll: A bundle of two Famicom Detective Club remakes released on Nintendo Switch.
the-sisters-party-of-the-year: Let's get into mischief! Join Maureen, Wendy and all their friends in this new video game adventure! Challenge your friends in crazy mini-games and explore the Sisters' city.
the-cruel-king-and-the-great-hero: This game is an RPG starring the human child Yuu, who longs to become a "hero," and the dragon "Overlord" who fosters her.
prinny-presents-nis-classics-vol-1: For the first time ever, both Phantom Brave and Soul Nomad & the World Eaters are coming to Nintendo Switch! imp-of-the-sun: Restore the Sun’s light and end the Eternal Eclipse in this 2D fast-paced action-platformer game inspired by Peruvian cultures. Explore hand-crafted environments, battle and improve your skills to defeat the Four Keepers that stole the power of the Sun.
a-musical-story: ‘A Musical Story’ is a rhythm game set against a 70s backdrop. A Musical Story is the debut game from independent French developer, Glee-Cheese Studio.
spelunker-hd-deluxe: Spelunker HD returns! Spelunker HD, which was released for PlayStation 3 in 2009 and won the PlayStation Store Special Award at the PlayStation Awards that year, has been revived with a full remake on PlayStation 4 and Switch as Ganso Minna de Spelunker.
dariusburst-another-chronicle-ex-plus: Taito's Darius series began with the titular arcade game, Darius, in 1986 and comprises numerous side-scrolling shooting games released in arcades, many of which were later ported to game consoles.
the-lightbringer: The Lightbringer is a poetic adventure/puzzle platformer with light combat elements, set in a beautiful world claimed by a vile corruption. Guided by your sister's spirit, you must prevail where she could not. Cleanse the corruption, become The Lightbringer.
youtubers-life-2: Become the trendiest youtuber in the world and live your dream. Make friends, deal with rivals, attend events, film and edit videos, and share it all !! Fame, Fortune and Fans are waiting for you.
mereks-market: Merek’s Market combines the craftsmanship, characters and chaos of running a medieval shop. Take ownership of a small shop as you haggle, barter and craft your way through a comical single player campaign or team up with friends to supply the whole town.
born-of-bread: Play as a flour golem who possesses a never-ending childlike wonder and a set of odd abilities. Team-up with a colorful cast of characters, explore the different regions of a wonderful world ripe with mysteries and engage in a fun and quirky turn-based combat system.
toy-soldiers-hd: Toy Soldiers HD is an action-packed strategy-based game in which you command antique WWI toy soldiers vying for control of the trench-filled battlefields of Europe. zorro-the-chronicles: Zorro: The Chronicles is an exciting and humorous game featuring combat and exploration gameplay inspired by the best action games in class.
frogun: Join Renata as she adventures across a world of mystical ruins with the titular FROGUN! Frogun is an old-school platformer with the soul of the PS1/N64 era, in which your frog-shaped grappling hook is a your best friend!
streets-of-rage-4-mr-x-nightmare: Streets of Rage 4 is bringing Max Thunder back to the playable roster. The beat-’em-up’s downloadable content, Mr. X Nightmare, will transform Max from mind-controlled boss character to playable fighter.
cross-the-moon: Something once great lies dormant beneath the cold streets of Armorica's isolated capital, L'Amour. When it sleeps it dreams, and when it dreams it hunts. the-tale-of-bistun: The Tale of Bistun follows an amnesiac stone-carver on his journey up the slopes of the Mount Bistun. cotton-fantasy: Cotton Fantasy (aka Cotton Rock ‘n’ Roll) retains the comical world of Cotton and Silk, the game features not only from the Cotton series but also the other shoot'em up such as Sanvein's "Time" System and Psyvariar's "Buzz" system.
mars-2120: MARS 2120 is a metroidvania with engaging melee combat inspired by classics like Super Metroid, Castlevania: Symphony of the Night, or Guacamelee! With the use of special abilities tied to elements like ice, fire, and electricity help Sgt.

ikai: Fear and anxiety prevail after the darkest tales from Japanese folklore come to life in this first-person psychological horror game. Set in a feudal era, Ikai revolves around the priestess of a shrine struggling to defeat the spirits of her past and her present.
g-darius-hd: Take flight in the iconic Silver Hawk and immerse yourself in thrilling gameplay with both modern HD-visuals or authentic retro-arcade graphics. Experience the conflicts between the Amnelia Kingdom and the merciless Thiima Empire that took place before the battle between the people of Darius and Belsar.
blackwind: Blackwind is a top-down sci-fi action game that puts you in the shoes of a teenager trapped inside a prototype battle armor suit during an alien invasion. Face off against enemies, cut through their ranks, and fight back to stop a planetary invasion.
mr-suns-hatbox: Mr. Sun’s Hatbox is a slapstick, roguelite platformer about getting the job done, no matter the cost. sondro-gomez-a-sunova-story: "Sondro Gomez: A Sunova Story" is an action-adventure platformer following the story of a failing musician named Sondro, who must seek and recover the wish-granting Mystic Orbs to repay his debt to the mysterious Masked Man. Can he find them before the many rogues of Sunova beat him to the punch?
river-city-saga-three-kingdoms: In River City Saga: Three Kingdoms, the characters of the Kunio-kun series run-amok in the world of Sangokushi. lumote-the-mastermote-chronicles: Meet Lumote, the squishiest bioluminescent creature, in this beautiful 3D puzzle platformer. Take control of the world’s inhabitants on a quest into the Great Depths to seize control from the Mastermote.
neptunia-sisters-vs-sisters: The "sisters" get their long-awaited star role in this genuine Neptunia series spin-off! The four younger sisters rise up to take back their share of the portable games market stolen by the mysterious smartphone called "MagiPhone." The character models that decorate game scenes are all-new, and the characters are…
circus-electrique: Circus Electrique is part story-driven RPG, part tactics, part circus management, and completely enthralling - all with a steampunk twist. When everyday Londoners mysteriously turn into vicious killers, only the show's talented performers possess the skills necessary to save the city.
baby-storm: Baby Storm is a cooperative party game. Watch over unpredictable kids as they unleash chaos in your kindergarten! Maintain order, run, clean and feed your way to the highest score, in solo or up to 4 players!
the-legend-of-heroes-trails-through-dayb: The Legend of Heroes: Trails Through Daybreak II is the twelfth installment in the main Trails series, serving as a direct sequel to the events of The Legend of Heroes: Trails Through Daybreak. An unexpected visit to the Arkride Solutions Office puts Spriggan Van Arkride to the matter.
snk-vs-capcom-card-fighters-clash: Characters from SNK and Capcom clash in this epic card fighting game! Introducing! SNK vs. Capcom: Card Fighters' Clash, a white-hot card fighting game for the Neo Geo Pocket Color (released in 1999), is coming to Nintendo Switch! Back then, SNK vs.
motogp-22: Start your engines! MotoGP 22 is the most immersive and realistic chapter of the racing simulator series MotoGP yet! Immediate fun from day one with the 2022 official season and the new split-screen mode to challenge your friends.
void-terrarium-2: From the developers at Nippon Ichi Software comes the second installment of the Void Terrarium series! With cloudAI defeated and Toriko saved from certain demise, a new deadly disease threatens her well-being once more. To save her, join Robbie and venture into the past to identify a remedy.
neverawake: A girl who never wakes up. She has been fighting monsters in her dreams... "NeverAwake" is a nightmarish twin-stick shooter with a unique worldview and original game rules.
tom-clancys-splinter-cell-chaos-theory: You are Sam Fisher, the NSA's most elite black-ops agent. slayers-x-terminal-aftermath-vengance-of: So.... got what it takes to be a X Slayer?!?... 7 weapons, blood and gore, twisted music by Seepage & Psyko Syndikate, and maps where you can blow up everything. its awesome. started making it in 1998 in high school with my friend and now im 37, so i have life experience now.
one-btn-bosses: It's One Button Bosses, it's all in the name. You have one button. There are big bosses to beat. Push, tap, and bash in the handcrafted campaign or in the roguelike rifts.

deadcraft: Farm the dead to stay alive in Deadcraft, a new twist on the zombie survival-action genre! As a half-zombie, grow an army of loyal undead followers and build an arsenal to equip them to take revenge on the rulers of humanity's last city.
gravitar-recharged: The cult classic Gravitar has been Recharged. Complete missions in each solar system, navigating a variety of challenging environments, each with varying levels of gravity that will test your skills as a pilot before unlocking new solar systems to explore.
backfirewall: It is a first-person tragicomic narrative adventure game that’s set inside a smartphone. You are the update assistant – solve puzzles to counter the update and save the previous operating system from deletion.
atari-mania: A wild journey through videogame history, Atari Mania is a microgame collection wrapped in an hilarious retro-driven narrative of exploration and surprise.
cuisineer: Explore the world of Cuisineer as you enter dungeons and defeat monsters to get vital ingredients to cook delicious food to serve at your restaurant in this super cute and tasty rogue-lite dungeon crawler!
valfaris-mecha-therion: Therion returns as the hunt for Lord Vroll continues. Pilot an advanced machine of death and destruction in this explosive 2.5D side-scrolling shoot ‘em up, and sequel to the critically acclaimed Valfaris. Strap in and unleash mecha hell!
graze-counter-gm: A refreshing and highly re-playable bullet hell style shooter that WANTS you to play dangerously! Ride the razor's edge of life and death in this high-risk high-reward danger oriented arcade style shooting game.

order-automatica: A dark tactical roguelite where positioning, synergies, and automated battles collide on a tiny 3x3 ritual grid. Like chess with demons.
disgaea-7-vows-of-the-virtueless: The next chapter in the Disgaea saga. In Disgaea 7, the story is set in a world called "Hinomoto Netherworld Cluster," which is inspired by Japanese culture.
voice-of-cards-the-beasts-of-burden: Voice of Cards: The Beasts of Burden, is a new standalone turn-based RPG adventure, that brings players to an illustrated world presented through the medium of cards as the third release in the Voice of Cards franchise, now giving players the ability to trap the monsters they defeat in cards to use them as skills in…
ten-dates: Ten Dates is the sequel to the interactive rom-com, Five Dates. Misha, a millennial from London in search of that elusive in-person connection, tricks her best friend Ryan into going to a speed dating event with her.
operation-wolf-returns-first-mission: Operation Wolf Returns: First Mission is the remake of the first Rail Shooter that shaped the genre. cavern-of-dreams: Cavern of Dreams is a mysterious, surreal adventure game inspired by N64 classics. You play as a young dragon who's just lost all of his unhatched siblings! gigantosaurus-dino-kart: Race around Cretacia in a prehistoric kart championship for up to 4 players of all ages, where you can play as your favorite dino friends and even bump into the mysterious Gigantosaurus himself!
astromeda: Astromeda is an adventure RPG, featuring unique fast-paced and turn-based battles in a mysterious, charming world. kingdom-two-crowns-pharaoh-lands: Pharaoh Lands is a DLC for the side-scrolling micro strategy game, Kingdom Two Crowns. Adventure within the Valley of Kings and discover the domain of powerful gods in an ancient Egypt-inspired setting as you uncover the source of the chaos throughout the land.
dave-the-diver-subnautica-2: Dave the Diver dives into the mysterious world of Subnautica 2 in an all-new crossover adventure. New waters, strange creatures, and unexpected discoveries await beyond the portal.
marvel-cosmic-invasion-the-siege-of-cast: Marvel Cosmic Invasion - The Siege of Castle Doom includes two new playable characters and a new game mode. The Fantastic Four's most powerful member and their greatest adversary are joining the fight against Annihilus!
tokyo-wanted: Hide-and-seek meets tag, in a crowd of 100. The stage is TOKYO. Slip through unseen and reach the goal, or work the wanted poster and stop the escape. A 3v3 team game between fugitives and hunters. Up to six players online at once; CPU fills any empty seats, so you can play solo.
sturmjager: Sturmjäger is a sci-fi shoot 'em up for everyone who wants to skip the cinematic fluff and dive straight into unadulterated, chaotic, and adrenaline-fueled arcade action. Master ten unique missions, either solo or with a friend in local co-op.
pokemon-timeless-diamond: Pokémon Timeless Diamond is an unofficial expansion hack of Pokémon Diamond Version. It was released alongside Pokémon Spaceless Pearl, which is a mod of Pokémon Pearl Version.
qubyte-classics-gaelco-sports-collection: Relive the thrill of 90s arcade games with 5 legendary, action-packed hits from Gaelco, a pioneer in the world of arcade gaming! Forget complex simulators; this collection is all about pure reflexes, instant fun, and high-speed adrenaline.
pokemon-spaceless-pearl: Pokémon Spaceless Pearl is an unofficial expansion hack of Pokémon Pearl Version. It was released alongside Pokémon Timeless Diamond, which is a mod of Pokémon Diamond Version.
overwatch-reign-of-talon-season-5-a-grim: The wait is over! Our newest Support Hero is here with the arrival of Doctrine. Freed from his volcanic prison by Doomfist himself, this sinister foe can manipulate life using his Eternal Scepter and mechanical drones, while also empowering each ability with his signature Infuse.
arcade-archives-2-balloon-bomber: "BALLOON BOMBER" is a shooting game released by TAITO in 1980. Control the anti-aircraft gun and destroy the balloon bombs as they gently sway through the air. However, destroying the balloon bombs is no easy task. Aim and shoot so your bullets hit only the bomb itself.
arcade-archives-2-xevious-3d-slash-g: "Xevious 3D/G" is a shooting game released by Namco Limited (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1996. The classic masterpiece "Xevious" is reborn in polygons! Everything is rendered in 3D with diverse screen angles and camera work, plus new weapons and enemy characters have been added.
arcade-archives-2-stinger: "STINGER" is a shooter released by SEIBU KAIHATSU in 1983. Take control of the "STINGER WOLF" and head to the center of an enemy base where evil life forms roam. In an emergency, you can call on the friendly robot "BONGO" to automatically destroy the enemy.
arcade-archives-2-thundercade: "THUNDERCADE" is a shooting game released by SETA in 1987. As a member of the special forces, use a high-speed motorcycle equipped with machine guns to reach the enemy stronghold. Destroying structures such as buildings will reveal power-up items in the form of sidecars equipped with gun barrels.
fire-emblem-fortunes-weave-expansion-pas: Expand the saga with new stories, allies, and more! Discover additional stories, enlist gods to your side, and more in DLC for the Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave game.
flearun: A retro, fast paced multiplayer on foot racing game for up to 4 players
g-mode-archives-plus-lost-savior: This is a port of a JRPG originally developed exclusively for mobile devices by Bandai Namco Entertainment. Embark on your adventure by choosing from six elements — Fire, Wind, Earth, Water, Dark, and Light — and a wide range of jobs, including Fencer, Scout, Mage, and Cleric.
moto-x--1: Revive the moto racing sipirit with this game, developed in 1994. Compete against motorcycles of 250cc, 550cc, and 750cc in different tracks full of obstacles and the best riders.Skills aren't going to be enough to win.
hello-peach: Peach is ready to play! Touch Peach's face to play together with your children in Hello, Peach! for Nintendo Switch. You can also play on Nintendo Switch 2!
don-bradman-cricket-jr: Out of the highly successful Don Bradman simulation series comes Don Bradman Cricket JR, the hard-hitting arcade cricket game. Step onto the pitch and feel the thrill of every shot, smash boundaries, outplay opponents and make every run count.
hyakume-no-hananie: A Horror Otome Game Set in a Village of Otherworldly Rituals. Tokyo, 202X. On the day of your twentieth birthday, a single letter arrives. You don't recognize the sender's name, but the return address bears the name of a village that was supposed to have vanished...
console-archives-ripple-island: Ripple Island was released by Sunsoft in 1988 for an 8 -bit home console. This is an adventure game in which the player takes on the role of the protagonist Kyle and goes on an adventure while operating 9 types of commands.
console-archives-the-drug-store: The Drug Store was released by Human in 1998 for a 32-bit home console. This is a simulation game where you manage a drug store, aim to open many stores, and increase your capital. Manage your business while considering locations, the types of products sold, customer demographics, and build the ultimate drug store!
arcade-archives-2-ace-driver-victory-lap: "ACE DRIVER VICTORY LAP" is a racing game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1996. The hit arcade racer ACE DRIVER returns with more speed, more excitement, and more competition than ever before!
fatal-fury-city-of-the-wolves-classic-ma: Unlocks the "Classic Mai Shiranui" alternate costume for Mai Shiranui.
kiwi-boing: Triple-jump, air dash, plant your beak on walls, leap off and more in this 3D collectathon platformer about a flightless bird that gets everywhere anyway. You crashed on tiny open-world islands, and you have places to be. Find secrets, Meet the locals, fix your plane and F off home (F is for Fly).
console-archives-raiden-project: Raiden Project was released by Seibu Kaihatsu in 1995 for a 32-bit home console. As a pilot of the ultra high-altitude fighter-bomber "Raiden" and "Raiden II", fight to save Earth from the invasion of Alien that suddenly appeared!
omni-growth: Humans invaded a massive galactic ship and nearly wiped out an ancient arachnid species. But one hatchling survived... Now you are the last hope of your kind. Explore the abandoned sections of the colossal spacecraft, hunt space insects and invaders, consume your prey, and evolve from a helpless creature into a deadly…
teenage-mutant-ninja-turtles-splintered-: Add Slash to the lineup- he's big, he's powerful, and he…loves candy? Use his claw and sheer strength to take down anyone in the way. Play with 5 new Artifacts while stomping through enemies with this latest playable character in TMNT: Splintered Fate.
seahorse-soap-patrol: When polluting sea creatures fill the ocean with trash, it’s up to the Seahorse Soap Patrol to clean things up! Float through different underwater biomes, blowing sud bubbles at naughty nautiluses, smelly sharks, and more! Pick up the trash and make the ocean a fresh, clean home for all to enjoy.
vixen-357--1: This Sci-fi simulation game is based on exciting story with various events and unique characters and epic battles with dozens of units.
becastled-traits-and-some-magic: This DLC adds mages and clerics to the kingdom’s army, along with a Mage School for training them. A new trait system introduces more than 40 modifiers that can shape each game with bonuses, drawbacks, or restrictions.
supermarket-tidy-up: Tidy up 4970 products your cat knocked off the shelves!
crocs-world-5: Croc is back for his fifth adventure! Jump, run and swim through 60 hand-crafted levels across four islands, packed with new enemies and huge boss fights. This time whole sections of the levels are constantly on the move — and in the gravity zones Croc simply carries on running along the ceiling.
the-spectrum-retreat-redux: An atmospheric first-person puzzle thriller set inside the Penrose, an isolated art deco hotel where you awaken with no memory of checking in. Solve color-based logic and spatial puzzles, manipulate your surroundings, and uncover the mystery behind your stay.
beyond-the-mist: M. Webb, the I.S.C. requests your immediate presence. Our previous keeper has vanished without explanation. A replacement is needed at once for the offshore lighthouse under our care. Report to the local office of the company as soon as possible. Do not be late.
no-mans-sky-forsaken: Meet strange traders, collect haunting mementos, deliver mysterious packages, construct an eerie corvette, jump between star systems with seamless warping and more in update 7.10, FORSAKEN! Introducing new spooky gameplay and bringing the full experience of No Man's Sky to iOS devices.
table-game-world-ccfolia: A virtual tabletop for playing TRPGs, board games, and murder mysteries online with up to eight people. Use digital cards, pieces, dice, and maps while players set their own rules and decide how each game unfolds.
arcade-archives-2-prehistoric-isle: "PREHISTORIC ISLE" is a shooting game released by SNK in 1989. As the protagonist heads to Greenhell Island to investigate a series of shipwrecks off the coast of the Bahamas, prehistoric dragons thought to have gone extinct launch a relentless attack.
arcade-archives-2-swimmer: "SWIMMER" is an action game released by TEHKAN (KOEI TECMO GAMES) in 1982. Take control of the swimmer and see if you can make it to the treasure island. Use Power Pills and dive underwater to skillfully avoid obstacles and enemy monsters.
pragmata-mega-man-pack: Mega Man love is out-of-this-world in this new bundle of outfits, gestures, and BGM. Get two new outfits for both Hugh and Diana—each with their own way of showing off that Mega Man spirit.
simsalagrimm-the-chaos-crystal: Dive into the fairy-tale world of Simsala! Join Yoyo and Doc Croc on a magical hidden-object adventure packed with puzzles and mini-games, restore order to the chaos and experience an exciting new story for the whole family!
minigolf-brake: Minigolf Brake! is a playful arcade minigolf game with a healthy dose of ridiculous doodles, weird golf balls, and questionable physics. The twist? You can brake your ball whenever you want. Slow down before flying off a cliff. Stop halfway down a hill. Fight your way uphill. Slide through the mud. Cross streams.
console-archives-marl-jong: Marl Jong was released by Nippon Ichi Software in 2003 for a 32-bit home console. This is a game in which you go on an adventure while competing in "Marl Jong" matches with the people of Marl Kingdom. With simple controls, gameplay progresses smoothly!
tidebreak: The storm is coming. Send it back! Take the controls as Rei in Tidebreak, a single-player arcade shoot 'em up where daring dashes turn enemy fire into a powerful counterattack. Fly seven stages, from Glasswater Reef to the Heart of the Undertow.
fortnite-chapter-7-mini-season-treasure-: Chests to crack. Crews to beat. Sprites to catch. Treasure to claim. Tempting, isn’t it? Fortunes are ready to be found… set sail in Treasure Hunters!
arcade-archives-2-elevator-action: "ELEVATOR ACTION" is an action game released by TAITO in 1983. As a Spy, your goal is to infiltrate the building and escape with all the confidential documents. Use elevators to crush enemies, attack them by shooting down lamps, and more.
arcade-archives-2-exzisus: "EXZISUS" is a shooting game released by TAITO in 1987. Control Cosmo Fighter Robin and defeat the mysterious army infesting the 4th Galaxy using your blaster and missiles. Each item collected powers Robin up, allowing it to transform into Turbo Jet mode or summon bird and dog animal robots to support you in attack.
fortnite-og-chapter-1-season-x--1: Reality is bending, timelines are colliding, and you’re dropping into the middle of it. A Reality Wave sweeps across the OG Island, transforming familiar locations and bringing in Rift Zones, new items, weapons and more.
